title: A referenced variable is evaluated even when only an untaken IF branch uses it
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[Test] = VAR Err = ERROR ( "evaluated" ) VAR NumCustomers = DISTINCTCOUNT ( Sales[CustomerKey] ) VAR Result = IF ( NumCustomers < 0, Err ) RETURN Result

expected.error: Err is referenced, so ERROR ( "evaluated" ) is evaluated when the variable is, whatever the condition

source.quote: even though we never return the Err variable, DAX needs to evaluate its value
source.supports: the article shows this measure (Test 1) producing an error

derivation: The measure is Test 1 of the article, evaluated per color as in a report. The number of customers is never below 0 (Red 3, Blue 2, Green none), but Err is referenced in the code, so it is evaluated and the query fails.
notes: The article notes the engine can remove the reference when the condition is known before execution (its Test 3, with COUNTROWS ( ALL ( ... ) )); DISTINCTCOUNT of a column is the form it shows failing.
